for f in $(rg -l "controlled-dialog" --glob '!node_modules'); do python3 -I - "$f" <<'E'
import re,sys
s=open(sys.argv[1]).read()
for m in re.finditer(r'import\s+(type\s+)?\{([^}]*)\}\s*from\s*"([^"]*controlled-dialog[^"]*)"',s):
    names=[n.strip() for n in m.group(2).split(",")]
    if any(re.fullmatch(r'(type\s+)?Dialog(\s+as\s+\w+)?',n) for n in names): print(sys.argv[1],names,"TYPE" if m.group(1) else "")
E
done; rg -n "controlled-dialog" --glob '!node_modules' | rg -v "import|from" | head

rg -n -B4 "controlled-dialog" --glob '!node_modules' apps packages | rg -n "Dialog\b.*,|\{ Dialog|Dialog \}|controlled-dialog" | head -150; sed -n 60,200p packages/features/components/controlled-dialog/index.tsx | rg export

rg -l 'import \{ Dialog \} from "@calcom/features/components/controlled-dialog"' --glob '!node_modules' apps packages | sort > /tmp/a.txt; wc -l /tmp/a.txt; rg -l "controlled-dialog" --glob '!node_modules' apps packages | sort | comm -13 /tmp/a.txt -; sed -n 10,25p apps/web/modules/bookings/components/OverlayCalendar/OverlayCalendarContinueModal.test.tsx
